articles.summary: FLOWER MOUND, Texas, April 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mannatech, Incorporated (NASDAQ: MTEX ), ("Mannatech" or "Company"), global health and wellness company committed to transforming lives to make a better world, today announced financial results for its fourth quarter and year ended 2025. Fourth Quarter Results Fourth quarter net sales for 2025 were $26.6 million, a decrease of $2.4 million, or 8.2%, as compared to $29.0 million in the fourth quarter of 2024.
